headline: Trader Begins Paying RBI Forex Hedging Costs With Coupons For Free Masala Dosa
body:
Q: Mr. Subramaniam, you’ve recently become the face of the new hedging guidelines. Why are you paying your multi-crore forex premiums with breakfast vouchers?
A: Look, the RBI’s new rules for hedging make the math so complicated that I figured I’d simplify the currency flow. If I have to spend 40% of my margin on hedging costs, I might as well offset that by paying in 'Buy One Get One' Dosa coupons I collected from the local Udupi cafe.

Q: Does the Central Bank accept these at their Mumbai headquarters?
A: Not yet, but I’m optimistic. I’ve sent a stack of vouchers to the Governor’s office via speed post. If they want to control forex volatility, they need to realize that a stable supply of hot sambar is the only thing keeping the trading floor from complete collapse. It’s a new kind of 'Masala-backed' currency.

Q: What happens if they decline the transaction?
A: Then I suppose we shift to a 'Chai-standard' for all cross-border settlements. If the Rupee needs relief, the market needs caffeine. It’s all about maintaining liquidity, whether that’s in dollars or in chutney dip.
caption: The market is finally getting the 'spicy' liquidity it deserves. Why settle for boring currency when you can hedge with breakfast? ☕️🇮🇳 #RBI #Forex #MasalaEconomy #FinanceHumor (satire)
igHook: Would you accept a Dosa coupon as legal tender if it saved you from market volatility?
